title: Task 1: Locate CodeSage Project Details & Stack
scenario: You are a recruiter or technical interviewer looking for Mokshi's project on compiler ASTs and code summarization.
goal: Navigate to the Projects section, search or filter for 'CodeSage', and open its detailed architecture modal.
targetPath: Projects section -> Search 'CodeSage' or filter 'NLP & Systems' -> Click 'View Architecture / Details'
successCriteria: User views the 6-stage AST pipeline modal and locates the GitHub repository link.

title: Task 2: Download / Inspect Professional Resume
scenario: You are reviewing applicant credentials and need a verified copy of Mokshi's resume PDF.
goal: Locate the primary resume CTA button in the hero section or header and trigger the resume download or preview modal.
targetPath: Hero section -> Click 'Download Resume' or Header -> Click 'Resume'
successCriteria: Resume modal opens with complete education, skills, and download confirmation.
hciPrinciple: Fitts's Law (High-visibility, prominent CTA above fold)

title: Task 3: Search and Read Technical Metagenomics Blog
scenario: You want to evaluate Mokshi's technical writing and machine learning depth on high-dimensional genomic embeddings.
goal: Navigate to the Blog section, filter or search for 'metagenomics' or 'VAE', and open the article.
targetPath: Blog section -> Tag filter 'Bioinformatics' or search 'VAE' -> Click article card
successCriteria: Article modal reader displays the complete technical article with headings and code formulas.

title: Task 4: Toggle Color Theme (Dark / Light Mode)
scenario: You prefer working in a dark workspace late at night and want to ensure the interface supports high contrast themes.
goal: Find the theme toggle control or press the 'D' keyboard shortcut to toggle between dark and light modes.
targetPath: Header -> Click Sun/Moon icon OR Press 'D' on keyboard
successCriteria: Interface updates background and text colors with smooth contrast transition and saves preference.
hciPrinciple: Flexibility & Efficiency of Use, WCAG Contrast Standards

title: Task 5: Validate & Submit the Contact Form
scenario: You want to invite Mokshi for an internship interview and need to send an inquiry with valid information.
goal: Navigate to the Contact section, test inline validation with an invalid email, correct it, and submit the message.
targetPath: Contact section -> Enter Name, Email, Subject, Message -> Observe validation hints -> Click 'Send Message'
successCriteria: Inline errors guide the user to enter a valid email, submission triggers loading state and success toast.
hciPrinciple: Error Prevention & Help Users Recover from Errors
